Each bound belongs to the interval named in its row; a bound is not a test inversion. Each column has one scale. Nominal: the odds ratio injected into the labels. Estimator: the same effect on the scale of the odds ratios of Eq.~(2) of the paper, read from the estimator's values on labels with known injected effects (interpolated on the log scale; beyond the largest effect used for this conversion, an injected odds ratio of 3, written as greater than the estimator's value there).
